## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2021-12-27: Up-C business combination with CompoSecure Holdings, L.L.C. closes; Roman DBDR Tech Acquisition Corp. renamed CompoSecure, Inc.; TRA executed (90% Net Tax Benefit, 160% aggregate-payment cap)

#### Amendment to avoid Change-of-Control acceleration

- 2024-08-07: Amendment No. 1 redefines Change of Control to exclude the Tungsten 2024 stock purchases; 10-K narrative also reports the early-termination discount rate increased to 15% per annum (up from LIBOR plus 100 bp)
- 2024-09-17: Amendment becomes effective at closing of the Tungsten transactions

#### Corporate restructuring and ongoing accruals

- 2025-02-28: Resolute Holdings Management spin-off; GPGI begins accounting for GPGI Holdings under the equity method
- 2026-05: Q1 2026 10-Q reports $293.3M aggregate expected future TRA payments; cumulative cash payments $5.3M (2025) and $1.3M (2024)

## Explanation

GPGI's TRA originated at the December 27, 2021 de-SPAC Up-C business combination between Roman DBDR Tech Acquisition Corp. and CompoSecure Holdings, L.L.C., obligating the public company to pay an above-market 90% of net tax benefit to the former CompoSecure Holders (principally the Logan Entities and the LLR Funds). Covered attributes are pre-merger common basis, Section 754/743(b)/734(b) basis adjustments on future exchanges of Class B units, and imputed interest; aggregate payments are capped at 160% of the initial consideration received for tax purposes. Amendment No. 1 on August 7, 2024 redefined Change of Control to exclude the Tungsten 2024 stock-purchase transaction (a Permitted-Investor-affiliated acquirer), preventing what would otherwise have been an accelerated TRA payment, and per the 2025 10-K MD&A also raised the early-termination discount rate to 15% per annum. The TRA remains in force; aggregate expected future payments stood at $293.3M at Q1 2026, with cumulative cash payments of $6.6M to date. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record and the amendment text.
